facts.fact: WHO states that Congo adopted a national strategic plan for the national health information system (SNIS) and e-health for 2020-2024 in November 2019, that its implementation is insufficient, and that there is no legislative or functional multisectoral framework coordinating the health information system.

WHO states that DHIS2 has been used since 2020 as the national warehouse 'at the peripheral level' for routine health data, enabling electronic aggregation, with data completeness of 87% and timeliness of 47.9% in 2024; the document does not say whether entry is at the facility or the district office.

systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de la Population (Direction des études et de la planification), with WHO support
systems.tiers: peripheral level since 2020 for routine health data; health districts to enter the health statistics yearbook questionnaire in DHIS2 (planned WHO support)

note: Nothing on electronic patient records. The value 'district' reads 'niveau périphérique' as the health district tier of the Congolese pyramid; the parent may prefer to leave it unvalued.
